subject: NovaHealth subprocessor roster, SOC 2 mapping, and supply-chain evidence
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@novahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NovaHealth subprocessor roster & SOC 2 mapping — initial delivery

Hi Alicia,

Thanks for sending over the questionnaire list. Attached are two artifacts to get started:

- subprocessor_inventory_20260814.csv (full roster with function, residency, and data-access notes)
- soc2_mapping_novahealth_20260814.xlsx (SOC 2 control -> Redwood controls crosswalk; includes references to evidence files)

Notes/highlights:
- The "Edge Logging" entry references our logging partner (LogFlow Inc.) — they store non-PII telemetry in us-west and have read-only KMS access via a dedicated key. More details in the CSV notes column.
- CAIQ answers: we have a partially-completed CAIQ mapping; we can prioritize the sections you flagged (encryption key custody, subprocessor chain-of-custody).
- SIG / SIG-Lite: we can provide a SIG-Lite package within 3 business days; full SIG typically takes longer due to attestation artifacts.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm whether residency for edge logging (LogFlow) at us-west is acceptable for NovaHealth.
2) Tell us the format you prefer for evidence delivery (single zip vs. shared Drive folder).
3) If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min sync on Thurs 8/18 to walk through the mapping.

Attachments: [Attachment: subprocessor_inventory_20260814.csv (CSV, 42KB)], [Attachment: soc2_mapping_novahealth_20260814.xlsx (XLSX, 78KB)]

Best,
Jordan Blake
Director, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@novahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurements Team <procurements@novahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 10:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaHealth subprocessor roster & SOC 2 mapping — initial delivery

Jordan —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the files. A few clarifying questions from the NovaHealth security and procurement teams (see cc):

1) Edge Logging (LogFlow Inc.): can you confirm whether logs ever contain patient identifiers in debug traces? If so, what redaction / filtering is applied before export?
2) KMS custody: you mentioned "read-only KMS access via a dedicated key" — does LogFlow have the key material, or are we using a transit-only model where Redwood holds key material? Are there HSM-backed keys (Y/N)?
3) Can you produce a short extract of the SOC 2 report that maps to CC6 (data handling) and CC7 (encryption) — a redacted PDF is fine.

Procurement: we are also tracking timing for contract signatures. Please include any evidence delivery timelines in your reply so we can update the internal SOW.

Attached is our internal checklist for evidence consumption.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Security Architect, NovaHealth
[Attachment: novahealth_evidence_checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 46KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 11:22:45 -0700
Subject: Fwd: NovaHealth subprocessor roster & SOC 2 mapping — internal cadence

Jordan — looping in Ben (security ops) and Laura (platform infra) to confirm the KMS/residency specifics Alicia asked about. Ben, can you give a short written answer on the following so I can send back to NovaHealth? Keep it high-level — they want to know:

- Does LogFlow ever receive key material (Y/N)? If N, what model do we use (transit, envelope)?
- Is any telemetry containing potential patient identifiers ever forwarded to the third party unredacted? If so, what controls are in place?
- Estimated timeline to produce the SOC 2 extract + a redacted PDF mapping to CC6/CC7.

Also Jordan: if we can propose a single delivery format (Drive link + bundled zip for download) that tends to speed procurement.

Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 13:40:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: NovaHealth subprocessor roster & SOC 2 mapping — internal cadence

Marissa / team — quick answers below; happy to pull additional artifacts if needed.

- KMS custody: LogFlow does NOT hold key material. We use an envelope encryption model where Redwood-managed HSM-backed keys (AWS CloudHSM / KMS with CloudHSM-backed key) perform decryption in transit only. LogFlow receives only ciphertext and limited metadata.

- Telemetry and PII: We have a telemetry filter pipeline that strips known PHI/PII markers before logs are forwarded. There is a short retention window in the pipeline for debugging (max 72 hours) and access is audited. We can provide the filter rule set as evidence if NovaHealth requests it.

- SOC 2 extract timeline: I can produce a redacted SOC 2 extract mapping CC6/CC7 by EOD Monday 8/17 (we'll remove auditor notes and client-specific references). Full SIG-Lite package: 3 business days from approval.

Evidence delivery recommendation: publish to a shared Drive folder (link below) and attach a single evidence_bundle_v1.zip for procurement download. I'll stage the CAIQ and SIG-Lite in the same Drive folder.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNovaHealthEvidence

Ben Carter
Security Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment stubs: filter_rules_v1.txt (TXT, 12KB) — available on Drive]

Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaHealth subprocessor roster & SOC 2 mapping — consolidated answers and delivery plan

Alicia —

Thanks for the questions and the checklist. Quick summary based on Ben's note (copied below) and attachments staged to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNovaHealthEvidence

Summary answers:
- LogFlow (edge logging): does NOT hold key material. We use an envelope model with HSM-backed keys.
- Telemetry: PHI/PII is redacted by the pipeline; short debug retention (<= 72 hours) with role-based access and audit logs.
- SOC 2 extract: redacted CC6/CC7 mapping is attached; Ben estimated delivery by EOD 8/17 for the extract and SIG-Lite in 3 business days.

Delivery format: per procurement preference we will:
1) Share a Drive folder with staged evidence (CAIQ, filter rules, SOC2 extract, subprocessor CSV).
2) Attach a single evidence_bundle_v1.zip for procurement to download and archive (contains redacted artifacts).

Attachments available for download: [Attachment: evidence_bundle_v1.zip (ZIP, 2.1MB)]

If that works, can we lock a 30-min sync on Thu 8/18 at 09:00 PT to walk the mapping? If that time doesn't work, offer two alternatives and we'll adjust.

Thanks again — happy to keep this moving.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Director, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
